_note: Nail bars (src/components/arcade/games/nails): NStyle Beauty Lounge (City Centre Deira, The Dubai Mall), N.Bar and The Nail Spa. A manicure: shape every nail, paint each one (coverage and spills on the skin are scored), add the design, then the UV lamp (hold for `uvSeconds`; letting go early smudges). Self mode does one of the wardrobe's nail sets (roster NAILS_CATALOG, by id) and puts it on your look; the technician job serves Local customers' orders, one level each, for tips.
